observed_values.qualitative_value: Google reported more than a dozen technical improvements and said policy-violating AI Overviews appeared on fewer than one in seven million unique queries where the feature appeared; no total affected-user count is available.

dimensions.assessment_basis: The preserved sources establish the bounded consequence described in the Incident summary: After Google expanded AI Overviews across U.S. Search, users surfaced odd, inaccurate and sometimes potentially harmful answers. Google acknowledged that some real failures resulted from misinterpreting queries, limited high-quality information, satire or user-generated content, and it implemented more than a dozen technical changes and additional triggering restrictions. Unreported downstream consequences were not inferred. Threshold applied: Meaningful but bounded collective, civic, democratic-process, public-institution or information-environment impact.
The preserved Incident evidence does not report a bandable materialised environmental impact; absence of reporting is not evidence of no harm.

source_first_review.note: Direct published primary-provider or contemporaneous accounts inspected; raw/private logs, source video and unauthenticated downstream effects are not claimed.

him_1_1_0_review.unresolved_basis: Google's postmortem distinguishes acknowledged inaccurate answers from fabricated viral screenshots and documents corrections. Neither inaccurate outputs nor generic Search reach alone demonstrates the historical S3 meaningful bounded community/civic/institutional consequence. Preserve historical S3 while actual affected decision pathway, collective effect and denominator are checked; do not infer patient injury or a verified mass harmed population.
him_1_1_0_review.additional_evidence_needed: Verify concrete erroneous outputs, actual affected audience and downstream collective/institutional effect or correction duration; separate modelled aggregate conditions from observed specific consequence.
him_1_1_0_review.aggregate_harm_routing: Mandatory deployed product/systemic behaviour screen applies; exact relevant encountered cohort and independent severity-consequence evidence are not established; no aggregate band may be assigned.
